boundaries.name: broker
boundaries.purpose: Sole action authority and the only production boundary that composes policy with connector dispatch.

boundaries.name: command
boundaries.purpose: Thin entry points and dependency composition; no domain or authorization decisions.

boundaries.name: connector
boundaries.purpose: External-system adapters exposing typed dispatch only to the broker boundary.

boundaries.name: domain
boundaries.purpose: Security-neutral business types and invariants without side effects.

boundaries.name: helper
boundaries.purpose: Small product-agnostic utilities and architecture tooling with no inward dependencies.

boundaries.name: persistence
boundaries.purpose: Metadata and immutable-artifact reference adapters implementing workflow ports.

boundaries.name: policy
boundaries.purpose: Authorization decisions and policy-domain behavior independent of adapters.

boundaries.name: provider
boundaries.purpose: Model-provider adapters implementing bounded workflow ports.

boundaries.name: transport
boundaries.purpose: Protocol translation into workflow ports plus delivery of immutable UI assets.

boundaries.name: ui
boundaries.purpose: Immutable generated Web assets; React and TypeScript stay build-time only.

boundaries.name: workflow
boundaries.purpose: Durable application use cases with model, action-authority, and persistence ports.
